about: Given the root Cargo.toml, each workspace member's [dependencies] or [build-dependencies] path dependency on another member is a crate edge named by package names, inline or as a [dependencies.<name>] table; a dev-dependency is none; a path dependency outside the members is refused

files.a/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "crate-a"

[dependencies]
serde = "1"
b = { path = "../b" } # inline

[dependencies.d]
path = "../d"

[dev-dependencies]
c = { path = "../c" }
